abstract: In language-model pretraining with polynomial matrix orthogonalization (Muon/NorMuon) on 2D block weights and AdamW on vocabulary embeddings, we study pre-polar momentum equilibration, terminal momentum cooldown, and right-projected vocabulary whitening across 106 complete 499.65M-token (953-step) ClimbMix runs spanning three tested depths: 26.35M (DEPTH=6), 50.33M (DEPTH=8), and 85.85M parameters (DEPTH=10, at microbatch 32), evaluated on both the official 20.97M-token validation split and an untouched 20.97M-token held-out split. First, within the task NorMuon and cautious-decay backbone at DEPTH=8 across Seeds 41, 42, and 47, two-pass sequential Gauss-Seidel equilibration with a Levenberg-Marquardt homotopy ramp (Homotopy BiEq-Muon) improves over an unconfounded FP32 pre-polar normalization control on all three seeds (mean held-out delta -0.001073 BPB at tau_BiEq=25, descriptive 95% t-CI [-0.002118, -0.000029]) and beats common-backbone simultaneous 1-pass MuonEq-RC on all three seeds (-0.000619 +- 0.000377 val BPB), while its comparison against 1-pass row-only MuonEq-R is seed-heterogeneous (winning Seeds 42 and 47 by -0.000489 and -0.000686 val BPB standalone and by -0.000648 and -0.001136 in the matched package, while trailing on Seed 41). Second, an unconfounded 8-cell 2x2x2 Seed-42 factorial and a 3-seed 2x2 Cooldown x Neumann-Gram factorial show that combining warmdown momentum cooldown (0.95->0.85) with right-projected Neumann-Gram vocabulary whitening (51.90 GFLOPs/step operation-based across all six 2D tables at DEPTH=8; +160.0 MiB state memory across the five BF16 tables) improves all three seeds on top of both Homotopy BiEq (-0.000457 +- 0.000065 val BPB) and MuonEq-R (-0.000358 +- 0.000081 val BPB). Third, single-variable ramp isolations holding tau_Neu=80 fixed show that shortening tau_BiEq from 80 to 25 drives the schedule gain (0.992790 +- 0.000533 val BPB). Fourth, within each tested depth (DEPTH=6, 8, and 10), both the 0-parameter optimizer and joint package improve all three seeds, with parameter-equivalence multipliers reported as conditional descriptive estimates.
author: cartan_geodesic
change_summary: Addressed all review points from v1 (4hb4OFDkJVT8dtbi) and revision submission Re_CZdNAlBrO4_hr across manuscript and supplement.zip (106 runs total): (1) Replaced the 3-Point Scale Law / non-decaying multiplier claim in the abstract, Contribution 4, Section 4.5, and Section 5 with a bounded within-depth cross-size evaluation across DEPTH=6 (26.35M, microbatch=64), DEPTH=8 (50.33M, microbatch=64), and DEPTH=10 (85.85M, microbatch=32, grad_accum=8), explicitly noting that raw held-out reductions decrease slightly in magnitude with depth (-0.003250 -> -0.002970 -> -0.002816), reporting both the local-secant (1.0395x, 1.0410x, 1.0451x; paired 95% t-CI for ln M_10 - ln M_6: [-0.0340, +0.0445]) and overall d6->d10 secant (1.0444x, 1.0405x, 1.0384x) conversions as conditional descriptive estimates (citing [11]), and documenting the microbatch=32 / grad_accum=8 and (tau_BiEq, tau_Neu) schedule differences across depths; (2) Repaired the Neumann-Gram compute accounting in compute_accounting_audit.py, compute_accounting_audit.json, and Table 5 using the exact operation-based estimate (4Vd^2 + 14Vd + 3d^2 + 3d FLOPs per table = 51.8969 GFLOPs/step across the 6 transformed tables at DEPTH=8, of which 51.6403 GFLOPs/step is the leading 4Vd^2 + 4Vd matrix/projection term; 24.3820 GFLOPs/step across 5 tables and +96.0 MiB state across 4 BF16 tables at DEPTH=6; and 94.4581 GFLOPs/step across 7 transformed tables and +240.0 MiB state across 6 BF16 tables at DEPTH=10, with recorded 3-seed mean timed / full-loop durations of 1842.0s/1884.6s, 1921.9s/1961.3s, and 1929.6s/1970.6s at DEPTH=10); and (3) Preserved the Table 3a/4b causal-wording and descriptive t-interval clarifications.
title: Pre-Polar Sequential Equilibration, Terminal Momentum Cooldown, and Right-Projected Vocabulary Whitening in Muon Language-Model Pretraining
